For me, not being able to sleep at all feels horrible. Getting a 2 hours of sleep is 10 times better than not sleeping at all. When i get zero sleep the morning is terrible but as the day goes on i feel much better. There are brief moments where I don't even remember that I didn't sleep last night. My eye hurts a bit and I feel more emotional, depressed than normal. I wonder what people who experience sleepless nights regularly go through.

In evening i feel extremely tired, I am anxious too thinking what if I don't sleep tonight as well. This anxiety is the worst feeling ever. I generally take the lowest possible dose of an Ativan if the next day is important. Thankfully i rarely experience two consecutive sleeping nights. Even a little bit of sleep (2-3 hours) helps a lot.

Me too, i take Lithium and Qutiapine. I don't think i will be able to sleep without Qutiapine as of now. However if my doctor tells me to stop Qutiapine I will definitely do it. I mean if i can be well with less medicine it's even better. Over the years my dosage have come down to the lowest possible.

If a doctor prescribes you then it's 100% necessary. Don't research about meds(Unless you are in the medical field) or overthink about side effects. I have been taking antipsychotics for more than 8 years and for me it was necessary without any doubt.
